title: POST /routes/{id}/versions – request
description: Create the next version of a route (version = previous + 1) and make it the current one. Versions never change afterwards. The checkpoints in order (position = index + 1), each once, all on the route's site; walk_time_from_prev_s is null at the first position. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 201, api/route-version.response.json.

id.description: Optional client-generated id (UUIDv7) of the new record; the server generates one if absent.

anyOf.description: Measured walk: last scan minus first scan during training, in seconds.
Measured walk from the previous position in seconds.
